visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a montage of various colorful Japanese snack packages (Sugar Butter Tree, Meltykiss, Galbo) on a shelf, with a pink title overlay. (2) A hand holds a red 'galbo' chocolate bag, then shows the beige-colored chocolate balls inside. A close-up reveals a cross-section of the bitten chocolate, showing a dark brown biscuit center. (3) The scene shifts to blue 'Sugar Butter Tree' packaging. A hand displays the individual blue and white wrappers, then holds a square, layered crispy biscuit. (4) A red 'Meltykiss' box is opened by a hand, revealing multiple small red foil-wrapped chocolates. One is unwrapped to show a square chocolate cube, which is then bitten to reveal a creamy caramel interior. (5) A yellow bag of Kameda Seika rice crackers is held against a store shelf background. (6) A red bag of UHA sweet potato chips is displayed. (7) The video concludes with a group shot of all the featured snacks arranged neatly on a white surface with the opened products displayed in front.
